scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "bun run dev:server" "bun run dev:client"
scripts.dev:server: cross-env PORT=3069 bun run --cwd packages/server dev
scripts.dev:client: cross-env CLIENT_PORT=3070 bun run --cwd packages/client dev
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "cross-env PORT=3068 bun run dev:server" "cross-env SERVER_PORT=3068 CLIENT_PORT=3071 bun run dev:client"
